question: Should OpenClaw bundle xAI Grok realtime voice for Talk gateway-relay now, with provider-local `ws` runtime dependency and default-off `sessionResumption`, after the barge-in clear bug, proof gap, and dependency approval are resolved?
rationale: This non-maintainer feature PR adds a bundled provider, provider auth/runtime dependency surface, and session-continuity behavior; automation can identify defects but cannot choose the product/security acceptance boundary.

options.title: Accept After Gates
options.body: Keep this PR open, require the barge-in clear fix, refreshed current-head live proof, and dependency-guard approval before merge.

options.title: Narrow First
options.body: Ask the contributor to remove or defer `sessionResumption` or other unproven behavior while preserving the basic gateway-relay provider.

options.title: Defer Out Of Core
options.body: Pause or close this PR and route xAI realtime voice to a plugin/ClawHub package or a later maintainer-sponsored core change.

recommendation.title: Accept After Gates
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require the barge-in clear fix, refreshed current-head live proof, and dependency-guard approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is product acceptance for a bundled provider plus dependency/security approval, and CONTRIBUTING.md lists steipete as the project owner.
